The team was founded in 1955 and reestablished in 2004, being for the most part of its history a participant in the [[Liga III|third division]] of the [[Romanian football]]. Unirea Slobozia has also spent several seasons in the [[Liga II|second division]], first in the early 1980s and then between 2012 and 2015, when also obtained 3rd place, the best ranking in the competition until then. Unirea promoted for the first time in history in [[Liga I|first division]] at the end of the [[2023–24 Liga II|2023–24]] season. "The Yellow-Blues" play their home games at the [[Stadionul 1 Mai (Slobozia)|Stadionul 1 Mai]], which can host 6,000 spectators."}}
